scope.definition: Every player who appeared in a FIFA World Cup squad from 1930 to 2022, plus a 2026 qualified/anticipated pool and current top-flight internationals.
scope.fictionalNote: One record — Gurman Singh Bindra — is a fictional entry supplied by the site's owner. It is flagged as fictional everywhere it appears and is not part of the defined scope.
scope.statement: This build ships a curated editorial subset of the defined scope. No player has been removed silently: the count shown on the Players page is the count in this file, and the gap to the full scope is stated in the UI and on the About page.

dataGaps: FIFA world ranking — no ranking feed in this snapshot
Country World Cup played/won/drawn/lost and goals for/against
Total attendance for pre-1950 and several later editions
Player photographs — photoUrl is null, so the UI renders a monogram avatar
Individual 2026 World Cup tallies — the tournament record is complete, but player career totals were recorded before the 2026 edition and are not folded in
Country appearance counts are through 2022; the full 2026 field is not in this snapshot
